members.name: id
members.doc: Stable identity, used by links. A node that survives a data change keeps its place and morphs.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name beside the node, in the tooltip and in the table.

members.name: color
members.doc: Any CSS color. First-column nodes default to the shared --series-* palette; later nodes default to a neutral ink.

members.name: source
members.doc: Id of the node the flow leaves.

members.name: target
members.doc: Id of the node the flow enters.

members.name: value
members.doc: Size of the flow. The ribbon is as thick as this value on the shared scale.

types.name: SankeyChartProps
types.doc: Use a Sankey chart to show how a total splits and recombines across two or more stages.

members.name: nodes
members.doc: Every node, in the order they should stack inside the first column.

members.name: links
members.doc: Flows between nodes. One link per source and target pair.

members.name: label
members.doc: What flows, such as "Visits by source and outcome". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: columns
members.doc: Optional heading above each column, such as ["Source", "Landing page", "Outcome"].

members.name: nodeWidth
members.doc: Width of each node bar in pixels.

members.name: nodeGap
members.doc: Vertical space between nodes of one column in pixels.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after each value, such as "visits".

members.name: formatValue
members.doc: Formats values in labels, the tooltip and the table.

members.name: activeId
members.doc: Controlled item in focus: a node id, or a link id written as "source>target". The rest dims while one is in focus.

members.name: defaultActiveId
members.doc: Item in focus on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.doc: Called when hover, touch or the keyboard moves the focus to another node or ribbon, or clears it.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
